summary: Frontend-only mobile retest: dashboard and calendar loaded, calendar month controls worked, but income/expense creation remained blocked because the modal Save control is outside the 390x844 viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844, record-save-button remains outside the viewport after opening Add income and filling the amount; Playwright cannot tap it even with force=True.

integration_issues.issue: Could not save records, so Husk auto amount, manual override, totals, and persistence after save could not be verified in this retest.

issues: The lower form controls are still unreachable on the required mobile viewport despite the inner ScrollView; modal height/scroll container needs a bounded mobile layout and reliable scrolling.

action_items: Fix RecordForm mobile layout so the ScrollView can scroll to record-save-button at 390x844, then rerun all creation, Husk calculation, override, totals, and persistence checks.
critical_code_review_comments: The form uses a ScrollView, but the live web preview still reports the Save control outside the viewport; verify bounded sheet height and scroll behavior rather than only adding ScrollView.
Delete Alert actions and several option controls still lack the requested dedicated testIDs.
seed_data_creation: No records created because Save was unreachable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at 390x844. Dashboard loaded and Calendar tab rendered August 2026; previous and next month controls both worked. Add income opened, but record-save-button was outside viewport after amount entry.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open Add income at 390x844, fill record-amount-input, tap record-save-button. Playwright resolves the button but reports it outside viewport after attempted scrolling. The modal sheet is bottom-aligned and its effective scroll region does not expose the lower controls in the web preview; likely missing bounded max height/flex scroll sizing or safe-area handling.
